entry.title: Geometrically Averaged Hard Target Updates for Linear Q-Learning

author.name: Donghwan Lee

entry.summary: Analyzes a lambda-target update for linear Q-learning that geometrically averages periodic hard target update maps, interpolating between one-period updates and projected Q-value iteration. Studies stability via a switching-system model.

entry.title: Pose-ICL: 3D-Aware In-Context Learning for Pose-Controllable Subject Customization

author.name: Xuan Han, Yihao Zhao, Mingyu You

entry.summary: Proposes Pose-ICL, a tuning-free framework using 3D-aware in-context learning with paired image-pose references to enable accurate pose control and cross-pose consistency in subject customization. Addresses 2D backbones' lack of volumetric object understanding.

entry.title: Democratising Camera Trap AI: An Open-Source Model for Detecting UK Mammals

author.name: Paul Fergus, Philip Stephens, Russell A. Hill, Lee Oliver, Katie Appleby, Sarah Beatham, Naomi Davies Walsh, Stuart Nixon, Naomi Matthews, Chris Sutherland, Kelly Hitchcock

entry.summary: Releases an open-source YOLO26x object detector for 31 classes covering 28 UK mammal and bird species plus utility classes, trained on 48,165 labelled instances over a decade of camera-trap deployments. Aims to democratize biodiversity monitoring away from commercial platforms.

entry.title: Disjoint or Overlapping? Inference Windowing for Reconstruction-Based Time Series Anomaly Detection

author.name: Guillaume Coulaud (UM, IROKO), Reza Akbarinia (IROKO), Florent Masseglia (IROKO)

entry.summary: Revisits reconstruction-based time series anomaly detection, studying how inference stride (disjoint versus overlapping windows) affects performance, and proposes a unified training, tuning, and multi-seed evaluation protocol on the TSB-AD benchmark. Addresses heterogeneous and underspecified evaluation practices.

entry.title: Discovering Interpretable Multi-Parameter Control Policies for Evolutionary Algorithms Using Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Tai Nguyen, Phong Le, Carola Doerr, Nguyen Dang

entry.summary: Uses deep reinforcement learning to discover interpretable multi-parameter control policies for evolutionary algorithms, using the (1+(lambda,lambda)) GA on OneMax as a case study where super-constant speedup is provably possible. It introduces algorithm-agnostic enhancements to overcome convergence issues in the multi-parameter setting.

entry.title: On the Controllability-Fidelity Frontier in Diffusion Editing

author.name: Yi Hu, Leying Yi, Emily Davis, Finn Carter

entry.summary: This paper provides theoretical and empirical analysis of trade-offs in controllable diffusion-based image editing, deriving bounds on reconstruction error, stability under repeated edits, and locality of changes. It covers text/mask-guided, drag, and inversion-based editing pipelines.

entry.title: Accelerating SAV-based optimization via randomized low-rank Hessian approximation

author.name: Ryo Sagawa, Daisuke Furihata, Yuto Miyatake

entry.summary: This paper proposes N-RSAV, a Nystrom-enhanced relaxed scalar auxiliary variable optimization method that incorporates curvature information via randomized low-rank Hessian approximation while preserving an unconditional modified energy dissipation law. It targets slow convergence on ill-conditioned problems such as physics-informed neural networks.

entry.title: Which LoRA? An Empirical Study on the Effectiveness of LoRA Techniques During Multilingual Instruction Tuning

author.name: Thamali Wijewardhana, Napoleon H. Reyes, Surangika Ranathunga

entry.summary: This empirical study finds no significant advantage of complex LoRA variants over basic LoRA for balancing cross-lingual transfer and knowledge retention in multilingual instruction tuning. Hidden embedding analysis shows layer-wise language representations remain similar across variants.

entry.title: Measuring Human Value Expression in Social Media Texts: Calibrated LLM Annotation and Encoder Transfer

author.name: Maria Milkova, Maksim Rudnev

entry.summary: This paper develops calibrated LLM annotation procedures for measuring human values in non-English social media using Schwartz's value theory, then transfers to encoder models for scalable prediction. It emphasizes theory-grounded, validated subjective measurement.

entry.title: SpineReport: Automated 3D Quantification and Reporting of Lumbar Spine Degeneration on MRI

author.name: Nathan Molinier, Adrian A. Marth, Reto Sutter, Christoph Germann, Jacob A. Connolly, Mathieu Guay-Paquet, Nathan D. Schilaty, Kenneth A. Weber II, Julien Cohen-Adad

entry.summary: SpineReport is an open-source framework for fully automated 3D morphometric analysis of lumbar spine MRI, providing reproducible quantification of degeneration beyond limited 2D measurements. It leverages robust anatomical segmentation for interpretable reporting.

entry.title: Improving PET/CT-Based Whole-Body Lesion Segmentation Using Prediction Uncertainty-Augmented Models

author.name: Bashirul Azam Biswas, Biratal Raj Wagle, Zhihan Yang, Marc A. Seltzer, Matthew E. Maeder, James B. Yu, Indrani Bhattacharya

entry.summary: This paper presents an uncertainty-aware framework for whole-body PET/CT lesion segmentation that augments nnU-Net with prediction uncertainty to improve consistency and recover missed lesions in high tumor-burden cases. It adds clinical reliability via uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: Fusing Satellite Imagery and Planimetric Maps for Cross-View Localization

author.name: Quang Long Ho Ngo, Zimin Xia, Alexandre Alahi

entry.summary: This paper proposes fusing satellite imagery and planimetric maps for cross-view localization, exploiting their complementary properties to improve ground-camera localization. It integrates both modalities into state-of-the-art methods.

entry.title: PF-Trans: Physics-Embedded Frequency-Aware Transformer for Spectral Reconstruction

author.name: Yuzhe Gui, Tianzhu Liu, Yanfeng Gu, Xian Li

entry.summary: PF-Trans is a physics-embedded frequency-aware transformer for spectral reconstruction from snapshot broadband filter array imaging, integrating the physical sensing model via mask injection and a dual-domain FFT branch to address spectral aliasing. It targets high-fidelity remote sensing spectral recovery.

entry.title: GRAR: Glass-induced Reflection Artifact Removal in LiDAR Point Clouds

author.name: Wanpeng Shao, Zeyi Guo, Bo Zhang, Yifei Xue, Tie Ji, Yizhen Lao

entry.summary: GRAR is a unified framework for removing glass-induced reflection artifacts in LiDAR point clouds, using a multi-modal vision foundation model for initial glass masks refined with geometric cues and glass completion. It avoids reliance on ideal reflection symmetry assumptions.

entry.title: Analyzing Training-Free Corruption Detection for Object Detection Datasets

author.name: Christian Sieberichs, Simon Geerkens, Thomas Waschulzik, Viswanathan Ramesh, Alexander Braun

entry.summary: This work analyzes training-free feature-space methods for detecting annotation errors in object detection datasets, showing they reliably expose semantic mislabels while highlighting limits for spatial errors. It adapts existing feature-space methods to the underexplored object detection setting.

entry.title: IDEAL: In-DEpth ALignment Makes A Discrete Representation AutoEncoder

author.name: Yitong Chen, Zijie Diao, Junke Wang, Lingyu Kong, Yixuan Ren, Bo He, Yu-Gang Jiang, Zuxuan Wu

entry.summary: Proposes IDEAL, a discrete representation autoencoder that combines shallow VFM features (rich local detail) with deep semantic features to improve reconstruction quality in semantically rich latent spaces. Targets better generative latent representations.

entry.title: HiMem-WAM: Hierarchical Memory-Gated World Action Models for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Xiaoquan Sun, Ruijian Zhang, Chen Cao, Yihan Sun, Jiahui Chen, Zetian Xu, Bo Chen, Haijier Chen, Zhen Yang, Jiarun Zhu, Yijun Hong, JingZhe Xu, Jingrui Pang, Mingqi Yuan, Jiayu Chen

entry.summary: Presents HiMem-WAM, a hierarchical memory-gated world action model integrating motion-centric latent actions, high-level skill latents, and boundary-triggered memory updates for long-horizon manipulation. Addresses task-relevant memory limitations in existing WAMs.

entry.title: GuideWalk: Learning Unified Autonomous Navigation and Locomotion for Humanoid Robots across Versatile Terrains

author.name: Haoxuan Han, Chen Chen, Linao Gong, Xin Yang, Hao Hu, Junhong Guo, Zhicheng He, Yao Su, Fenghua He

entry.summary: Presents GuideWalk, a unified end-to-end framework integrating traversability-aware navigation guidance with terrain-adaptive humanoid locomotion via composite teacher distillation. Decouples obstacle avoidance from terrain conditions for robust navigation.

entry.title: Planar-Sector LOS Guidance for Interception of Agile Targets with Lifting-Wing Quadcopters

author.name: Linkai Liu, Kun Yang, Han Zou, Chen Min, Shuli Lv, Shuai Wang, Quan Quan

entry.summary: Develops LieIPM, a Lie group interior point method for direct trajectory optimization of rigid bodies that performs Newton-type updates while preserving manifold structure, avoiding singularities of Euclidean optimizers. Strong control-theory team.

entry.title: Intrinsic Footpoint-invariant Riemannian Cross-covariance

author.name: Carlos Soto, Cheng Wang, Zipan Huang, Xiaoyu Chen

entry.summary: Introduces an intrinsic, footpoint-invariant Riemannian cross-covariance for manifold-valued random objects, defining covariance via parallel transport to a common tangent space independent of coordinate choices. Extends second-order statistics to nonlinear manifolds.

entry.title: Towards a Formal Scientific Epistemology

author.name: Richard_Ngo

entry.summary: Richard Ngo argues that Bayesian epistemology, which assumes truth lies within a fixed hypothesis class, is inadequate for hard problems, and proposes a science-inspired alternative that assigns degrees of truth to models of the world and emphasizes constructing new theories rather than just empirical updating. It is a conceptual contribution to epistemology relevant to how we reason under deep uncertainty about AI.

entry.title: Beyond Static Evaluation: Co-Evolutionary Mechanisms for LLM-Driven Strategy Evolution in Adversarial Games

author.name: Haoran Li, Zengle Ge, Ziyang Zhang, Xiaomin Yuan, Yui Lo, Qianhui Liu, Bocheng An, Dongke Rong, Jiaqun Liu, Annan Li, Jianmin Wu, Dawei Yin, Dou Shen

entry.summary: Proposes co-evolutionary mechanisms (evaluator co-evolution, hierarchical deep evaluation, weakness pressure) to address shifting evaluation landscapes when LLM-driven strategy evolution improves in adversarial multi-agent games. Tackles evaluator unreliability and evolutionary stagnation.

entry.title: Self-EmoQ: Plutchik-Guided Value-based Planning to Drive Streaming Emotional TTS

author.name: Yue Zhao, Hongyan Li, Yong Chen, Luo Ji

entry.summary: Proposes Self-EmoQ, an emotion-planning framework that determines emotion before text generation to drive streaming emotional TTS, implemented as a plug-and-play LLM module trained with RL using Plutchik's wheel of emotions for theory-driven rewards. Outperforms baselines on several dialogue datasets.

entry.title: Does Normalization Choice Matter for Causal Large Time-Series Models?

author.name: Samy-Melwan Vilhes (LMAC), Gilles Gasso (LMAC), Mokhtar Z Alaya (LMAC)

entry.summary: Investigates whether normalization choice matters in causal large time-series models, highlighting that standard normalization can leak future information during training and evaluating causal-normalization alternatives. It clarifies practical implications that prior work left underexplored.

entry.title: MetaPlate: Counterfactual-Guided RAG-LLM Tool for Personalized Food Recommendation and Hyperglycemia Prevention

author.name: Asiful Arefeen, Carol Johnston, Hassan Ghasemzadeh

entry.summary: Presents MetaPlate, a counterfactual-explanation-guided RAG-LLM decision-support tool that generates personalized meal recommendations to mitigate postprandial glucose excursions, integrating continuous glucose monitoring with actionable guidance. It moves beyond purely predictive glycemic-response models toward actionable counterfactual recommendations.

entry.title: RAT: Reference-Augmented Training for ASV Anti-Spoofing

author.name: Vojt\v{e}ch Stan\v{e}k, Anton Firc, Jakub Re\v{s}, Kamil Malinka

entry.summary: Introduces Reference-Augmented Training (RAT) for anti-spoofing, observing that conditioning on speaker-reference recordings induces an invariance improving deepfake detection even when references are absent or mismatched at inference. The reference contribution rapidly diminishes during optimization.

entry.title: Data assimilation for subsurface flow using latent diffusion model parameterization: performance of ensemble-Kalman and Monte Carlo techniques

author.name: Guido Di Federico, Wenchao Teng, Louis J. Durlofsky

entry.summary: Compares ensemble-Kalman and Monte Carlo data assimilation techniques for subsurface flow using latent diffusion model parameterization on large-scale 3D channelized geomodels. Examines how LDM mapping nonlinearity affects Kalman-gain-based ensemble updates.

entry.title: Operator Fusion for LLM Inference on the Tensix Architecture

author.name: Qingbo Wu, Ke Li, Wenzhu Wang, Jie Yu, Ruian Zhang, Lili Liu

entry.summary: Proposes an operator fusion strategy for Transformer inference on Tenstorrent's Tensix architecture, fusing RMSNorm with matrix multiplication and using NoC-based multicast for multi-core parallelism to reduce DRAM traffic. Demonstrates speedups on Qwen models on the Wormhole platform.

entry.title: Convergence Rates for Neural-Network Estimation with Current-Status Data

author.name: Yuan Wu, Tianhui Zhou

entry.summary: This paper establishes explicit convergence rates for a neural-network sieve maximum likelihood estimator of the conditional CDF under current-status data, combining ReLU approximation theory with empirical-process arguments. It provides theoretical support for neural estimation under interval-censored observation.

entry.title: Trading Utility for Dynamic Fairness in Multiple Resource Division with Sequential Demand

author.name: Kaiqi Jiang, Karim El Husseini, Wenzhe Fan, Xinhua Zhang

entry.summary: This paper proposes a neural allocation mechanism for dynamic multi-resource allocation that reconciles fairness criteria (Sharing Incentive, Envy Freeness, Dynamic Pareto Optimality) with system utility via multi-objective optimization during sequential rollout. It formalizes fairness with stepwise loss functions in the dynamic demand setting.

entry.title: Correcting Variable Importance Scored by Random Forests

author.name: Guancheng Zhou, Haiping Xu, Jason Liu, Donghui Yan

entry.summary: This paper proposes correcting Random Forest variable importance scores by grouping variables according to their conditional correlations to prevent masking effects where correlated variables receive artificially low importance. It addresses a known bias in widely-used RF feature importance.

entry.title: Generative Archetype-Grounded Item Representations for Sequential Recommendation

author.name: Yifan Li, Jiahong Liu, Xinni Zhang, Hao Chen, Yankai Chen, Wenhao Yu, Jianting Chen, Irwin King

entry.summary: GenAIR enhances sequential recommendation with generative archetype-grounded item representations, addressing the gap between static LLM semantic encodings and actual user behavioral patterns. It incorporates target audience information into item identity.

entry.title: UMI-Bench 1.0: An Open and Reproducible Real-World Benchmark for Tabletop Robotic Manipulation with UMI Data

author.name: Shi Jin, Yuntian Wang, Yuhui Duan, Di Wu, Gaoqi Dong, Xiaohang Liu, Xiaotong Li, Hongfei Jia, Zehao Zhang, Tianyu Wang, Zhongjie Jia, Yuanqi Yao, Chenjia Bai, Zhaxizhuoma, Siao Liu, Nieqing Cao, Jin Wang, Chao Yu, Yan Ding

entry.summary: Introduces UMI-Bench 1.0, claimed first real-world benchmark dedicated to evaluating UMI-style tabletop manipulation policies, standardizing the data-collection-to-deployment pipeline. Enables reproducible real-robot evaluation.

entry.title: Information-Preserving Continuous Occupancy Mapping with Variance-Weighted Submap Joining

author.name: Zhuhua Bai, Yingyu Wang, Liang Zhao, Shoudong Huang

entry.summary: Proposes the first continuous probabilistic submap-joining framework for SLAM that jointly optimizes poses and a global occupancy field in log-odds space using an information-preserving sparse Bayesian formulation. Improves smoothness and uncertainty handling over discrete-grid methods.

entry.title: AgniNav: Configuration-Driven Cross-Embodiment Local Planning for Robot Navigation

author.name: Tianhao Zang (Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo, China, University of Nottingham, Nottingham, UK), Siwei Cheng (University of Science and Technology of China, Hefei, China), Haidong Huang (University of Nottingham, Nottingham, UK), Shanze Wang (Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo, China), Wei Zhang (Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo, China)

entry.summary: Introduces AgniNav, a configuration-driven cross-embodiment local navigation framework that standardizes transfer via a four-parameter collision envelope and predicts a pseudo-laserscan from monocular images conditioned on robot height. Enables transfer from wheeled to legged platforms without retraining or depth hardware.

entry.title: Regimes: An Auditable, Held-Out-Gated Improvement Loop Demonstrated on LongMemEval with ActiveGraph

author.name: Yohei Nakajima

entry.summary: Presents Regimes, an auditable self-improvement loop built on an event-sourced agent runtime where state is a deterministic projection of an append-only log, making failures replayable and improvement decisions first-class events. Demonstrated on LongMemEval with the ActiveGraph system.

entry.title: EstRTL: Functional Estimation Guided RTL Code Generation

author.name: Qi Xiong, Renzhi Chen, Bowei Wang, Yuqing Xiong, Libo Huang, Lei Wang

entry.summary: Presents EstRTL, an LLM-powered collaborative framework for register-transfer-level hardware code generation that emphasizes functional correctness via functional estimation guidance, beyond mere compilation. It targets accelerating hardware design automation.

entry.title: Representation Curriculum: Stagewise Training for Robust Ranking and Allocation

author.name: Ehsan Ebrahimzadeh, Sina Baharlouei, Abraham Bagherjeiran

entry.summary: Proposes Representation Curriculum, a stagewise training strategy for ranking and allocation systems that prevents over-reliance on exposure-confounded shortcut signals like popularity and CTR. It steers learning toward exposure-independent merit signals to avoid entrenching incumbents.

entry.title: Sigma-Branch: Hierarchical Single-Path Network Reconstruction for Dynamic Inference with Reduced Active Parameters

author.name: Kohga Tanaka, Hiroaki Nishi

entry.summary: Proposes Sigma-Branch, which restructures a pretrained dense network into a hierarchical binary tree with shared backbone, routers, and specialized leaves to reduce per-inference off-chip weight transfer on edge accelerators. It distributes weights via activation-based spherical k-means clustering.

entry.title: Between Amnesia and Chaos: A Memory Stability Expressivity Trilemma for Trainable Dissipative Oscillator Networks

author.name: Caleb Munigety

entry.summary: Establishes a trilemma for trainable dissipative oscillator networks showing memory horizon, gradient stability, and dynamical expressivity cannot be simultaneously maximized because all three are governed by damping. It challenges the convention of freezing physical reservoir substrates.

entry.title: HydraCIL: Decoupled Class-Incremental Learning through Prototype-Guided Multi-Head Classifiers

author.name: Daniel Vila-Cruz, Laura Mor\'an-Fern\'andez, Ver\'onica Bol\'on-Canedo

entry.summary: Presents HydraCIL, a decoupled class-incremental learning model that freezes the backbone and creates lightweight prototype-guided per-task classifier heads, selecting the appropriate head at inference via prototype similarity. It targets resource-constrained embedded and edge deployment.

entry.title: Exploration of Foundation Model-Based Robots in Patient and Elderly Care

author.name: Zhiwen Qiu, Wei Liu, Yuexing Hao

entry.summary: This Perspective synthesizes the current state of foundation-model-based robots in patient and elderly care across design features, user experience, and care outcomes. It finds that most systems use foundation models as conversational/reasoning layers and questions whether technical advances translate to reliable clinical impact.

entry.title: Linguistically Augmented Audio Speech Data (LinguAS)

author.name: Ashley R. Keaton, Zahra Khanjani, Christine Mallinson, Vandana P. Janeja

entry.summary: LinguAS is a dataset of genuine and deepfaked audio samples annotated with five expert-defined linguistic features characteristic of natural human speech, going beyond frame-level acoustic features. It aims to enable deepfake detection that leverages linguistic cues at larger timescales.

entry.title: Building Change Detection in Earthquake: A Multi-Scale Interaction Network and A Change Detection Dataset

author.name: Yunlong Liu, Zekai Zhang

entry.summary: This paper introduces a multi-scale interaction network for building change detection after earthquakes and releases TUE-CD, a Turkey earthquake change detection dataset with short imaging intervals for post-disaster damage assessment. It addresses the absence of short-interval datasets for emergency rescue applications.

entry.title: Accounting for AI Inference in Corporate GHG Inventories: A Four-Tier Methodology for Scope 3 Category 1 Reporting

author.name: Guillermo Llopis (SOMA AI, Barcelona)

entry.summary: Introduces a four-tier methodology for accounting AI inference emissions under Scope 3 Category 1 corporate sustainability reporting, arguing current generic factors overestimate emissions by 10-40x. Provides a practical framework for matching estimation precision to available data.

entry.title: Modeling Complex Behaviors: Multi-Personality Composition and Dynamic Switching in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Peiqi Jia (Xi'an Jiaotong University), Haonan Jia (Beihang University), Ziqi Miao (Beihang University), Linkang Du (Xi'an Jiaotong University), Yuntao Wang (Xi'an Jiaotong University), Zhou Su (Xi'an Jiaotong University)

entry.summary: Establishes a systematic framework for explicit personality conditioning in multimodal LLMs covering single-personality induction, multi-personality composition, and dynamic switching. Finds personality induction helps captioning but can impair precise reasoning tasks like VQA.

entry.title: TRAPS: Therapeutic Response Analysis via Pathway-informed Stratification

author.name: Sujoy Banik, Sayantan Chakraborty, Boishakhi Das Toma, Zainab Ghafoor, Ushashi Bhattacharjee, Koushik Howlader, Tirtho Roy

entry.summary: Presents TRAPS, the first unified benchmark for pathway-guided cancer therapy response modeling, comparing three biologically-informed architectures across five TCGA cohorts (2,622 patients) on joint targeted-therapy, radiation, and survival prediction tasks. It enables fair architectural comparison previously impossible.

entry.title: Data-aware Static Analysis: Improving Detection of Semantic Faults in Machine Learning Code Using Data Characteristics

author.name: Willem Meijer, Kristian Sandahl, D\'aniel Varr\'o

entry.summary: This paper proposes a data-aware static analysis approach to detect semantic faults in ML code by combining data and control flow analysis with API contracts. It enables developers to catch bugs while coding rather than after training.

entry.title: The Order Matters: Sequential Fine-Tuning of LLaMA for Coherent Automated Essay Scoring

author.name: Ali Keramati, Mark Warschauer

entry.summary: This paper investigates task-aware fine-tuning of LLaMA-3.1-8B for automated essay scoring using LoRA, comparing sequential, independent, and randomized training curricula on the PERSUADE 2.0 corpus. It finds that sequential fine-tuning respecting discourse element dependencies yields the strongest results.

entry.title: Sleep EEG Signal Criticality as a Non-Invasive Predictor of Cognitive Decline in Dementia

author.name: Stanis{\l}aw Nar\k{e}bski, Tomasz Komendzi\'nski, Tomasz M. Rutkowski

entry.summary: This study investigates whether sleep EEG signal criticality, quantified via multifractal detrended fluctuation analysis, serves as a non-invasive biomarker for future cognitive decline. It finds significant group-level differences in Hurst exponent distributions during non-REM stages between cognitively healthy and later-impaired individuals.

entry.title: Large Language Models as Modal Models in Linguistics

author.name: Haruto Suzuki, Saku Sugawara

entry.summary: This conceptual paper applies the philosophy-of-science framework of modal modeling to argue that LLMs possess genuine epistemic value as minimal models in linguistics, even without structural correspondence to human cognition. It positions LLMs as providing how-possibly explanations for linguistic theory.

entry.title: FSS-Net: Frequency-Spatial Synergy Network with Wavelet Attention for Carotid Artery Ultrasound Segmentation

author.name: Jiawei Liu, Zhijiang Wan, Junhua Hu, Rongli Zhang, Zhongbiao Xu, Yankun Cao, Yuan Chen, Jin Hong

entry.summary: FSS-Net is a frequency-spatial synergy network with wavelet attention for carotid artery ultrasound segmentation, integrating wavelet transform, multi-domain attention, and edge enhancement to handle speckle noise and blurred boundaries. It aims at noise-robust stroke-risk assessment.

entry.title: Geometric Coastline Localization using Vision-Language Models

author.name: Rafia Malik, Bernhard Pfahringer, Karin Bryan, Mark Dickson, Eibe Frank

entry.summary: This work reformulates coastline detection as geometric boundary localization using vision-language models rather than pixel-wise segmentation with post-processing. It treats coastline geometry as the primary learning objective for coastal change analysis.

entry.title: ChartLens: A Dual-Branch Framework for Chart Data Correction and Factual Summary Refinement

author.name: Hao Liu, Ruping Cao, Kun Wang, Zhiran Li, Fan Liu, Yupeng Hu, Liqiang Nie

entry.summary: ChartLens is a dual-branch framework for chart understanding that recovers structured chart data and refines factual summaries via structure-aware CSV verification and text-retention-guided summary refinement. It won a chart understanding challenge track.

entry.title: Rethinking Embodied Navigation via Relational Inductive Bias

author.name: Weitao An, Chenghao Xu, Xu Yang, Cheng Deng

entry.summary: Proposes DB-Nav for embodied object navigation, using dual relational inductive biases to identify which semantic cues are unreliable and avoid contaminated mapping from false positives and stale priors. Reshapes the search space via target-centric relations.

entry.title: Language-Driven Cost Optimization for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Diego Martinez-Baselga, Khaled Mustafa, Javier Alonso-Mora

entry.summary: Presents a language-driven framework where an LLM interprets scenario descriptions and user queries to generate parameters for a risk-aware MPPI controller in autonomous driving. Enables adaptive cost-function tuning without technical expertise.

entry.title: What Spatial Memory Must Store: Occlusion as the Test for Language-Agent Memory

author.name: Doeon Kwon, Junho Bang

entry.summary: Tests whether spatial geometry adds value to language-agent memory-palace systems, finding that the default linear blend of proximity with recency hurts recall while geometry-led weighting wins decisively for spatial queries. Argues recall and visibility must be separated, using occlusion as the key test.

entry.title: Monte Carlo Pass Search: Using Trajectory Generation for 3D Counterfactual Pass Evaluation in Football

author.name: Andrew Kang, Priya Narasimhan

entry.summary: Recasts football pass evaluation as a Monte Carlo Tree Search-like problem combining a possession value model, a multi-agent trajectory world model, and a policy over counterfactual passes. Uses the first public high-fidelity 3D ball tracking dataset from the Bundesliga.

entry.title: Detecting Knowledge Gaps from Conversational AI Interactions Using Curriculum Prerequisite Graphs

author.name: Youssef Medhat, Junsoo Park, Ploy Thajchayapong, Ashok K. Goel

entry.summary: Builds a pipeline mapping student questions from a conversational AI teaching assistant to curriculum topics using a GPT-4-extracted prerequisite knowledge graph, achieving 80% classification accuracy. Question volume correlates with self-reported student difficulty, surfacing knowledge gaps.

entry.title: LLM-as-a-Discriminator: When Synthetic Tables Still Look Real

author.name: Manel Slokom, Malek Slokom, Thierno Kante

entry.summary: Proposes using an LLM as a discriminator to classify tables as real or synthetic, testing table-only versus table-plus-metadata settings with LLaMA and Gemini across three synthesis models on two public datasets. Offers a privacy-auditing approach for synthetic tabular data.

entry.title: SPDM: Geometry-Modulated State Space Modeling with Manifold Constraints for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Xingsheng Chen, Siu-Ming Yiu

entry.summary: Proposes SPDM, a state-space model for multivariate time series that treats evolving cross-variable correlations as a trajectory on the symmetric positive definite manifold, using Riemannian geometry as a regularizer for selective scanning. It aims to preserve geometric structure that standard SSMs discard.

entry.title: Revisiting Positive Samples in Graph Contrastive Learning: From the Perspective of Message Passing

author.name: Lianze Shan, Ningchong Wang, Jitao Zhao, Di Jin, Dongxiao He

entry.summary: Revisits the role of positive samples in graph contrastive learning, surprisingly finding GCL can stay competitive without them, and explains this via Dirichlet energy showing message passing already trivializes positive-sample alignment. It offers a mechanistic re-examination of a core GCL assumption.

entry.title: N-GRPO: Embedding-Level Neighbor Mixing for Enhanced Policy Optimization

author.name: Xukun Zhu, Hang Yu, Peng Di, Linchao Zhu

entry.summary: Duplicate id placeholder for SPACR.

entry.title: Spiking Neural Network inference on FPGAs with hls4ml

author.name: Barry M. Dillon

entry.summary: This paper extends the hls4ml toolkit to enable clock-driven deployment of spiking neural networks trained in PyTorch onto FPGA firmware. It demonstrates low-latency inference on the Heidelberg Spiking Digits dataset for real-time scientific systems.

entry.title: On-sky demonstration of reinforcement learning for adaptive optics control

author.name: Jalo Nousiainen, Vincent Chambouleyron, Benoit Neichel, Sylvain Cetre, Jean-Francois Sauvage, Angelie Alagao, Markus Kasper, Jonathan Dray, Romain Fetick, Byron Engler

entry.summary: This paper analyzes bidirectional random projections for OLS regression under fixed design, deriving an expected excess loss bound for the estimator built on projected data in both sample and feature dimensions. It compares against single-direction projection bounds and validates on real data.

entry.title: DMT: Demographic Conditioning, Morphology-Enhanced Transformer for Cuffless Blood Pressure Estimation from PPG Signals

author.name: Yidan Shen, Neville Mathew, Maham Rahimi, Deependra Dhakal, George Zouridakis, Xin Fu, Renjie Hu

entry.summary: DMT is a demographic-conditioned, morphology-enhanced Transformer for cuffless blood pressure estimation from PPG signals, using self-attention to capture long-range dependencies across cardiac cycles. It addresses amplitude shortcuts and integrates demographic covariates beyond late fusion.

entry.title: ClinReadNet: A clinical reading-inspired network for low-dose abdominal CT image quality assessment

author.name: Xianye Xiao, Yulong Zou, Yujie Luo, Taihui Yu, Cun-Jing Zheng, Yuan-ming Geng, Shuihua Wang, Yudong Zhang, Jin Hong

entry.summary: ClinReadNet is a deep learning framework for no-reference quality assessment of low-dose abdominal CT images that mimics radiologists' reading logic, combining a Sobel ordinal quality network with multi-scale temporal attention. It aligns design with clinical image-reading habits.

entry.title: A Multimodal RGB and Events Dataset for Hand Detection in First-Person View

author.name: Bharghav Kota (Zurich University of Applied Sciences, W\"adenswil, Switzerland), Yulia Sandamirskaya (Zurich University of Applied Sciences, W\"adenswil, Switzerland)

entry.summary: This paper introduces a multimodal RGB and event-camera dataset for first-person-view hand detection, leveraging event cameras' high dynamic range and temporal resolution to overcome motion blur in robotic systems. It proposes a methodology and synthetic data generation to address training data scarcity.

entry.title: AnimaSpark: A Feed-Forward Method for Animating Arbitrary 3D Objects

author.name: Yiming Zhao, Haoyu Sun, Aoyu Wang

entry.summary: Proposes AnimaSpark, a feed-forward pipeline for category-agnostic 3D animation generation, modeling joint transformations to improve speed, motion quality, and prompt adherence. Addresses a bottleneck in automated 3D asset production.

entry.title: A Spiking Neural Architecture for Coordinating Arm and Locomotor Control

author.name: Lea Steffen, Kathryn Simone, Graeme Damberger, Travis DeWolf, Hudson Ly, Chris Eliasmith

entry.summary: Presents a spiking neural architecture coordinating force-based arm control and bipedal locomotion in a simulated humanoid using the Neural Engineering Framework and a biologically grounded basal ganglia model. Addresses integrated, energy-efficient neuromorphic motor control.

entry.title: GUIDE: Goal-Initialized Directional Understanding for End-to-End Visual Navigation

author.name: Liang Wang, Jin Jin, KanZhong Yao, YiBin Wu, Fangqiang Ding, Jin Wang, Jun Wu, Zhe Sun, Qiuguo Zhu

entry.summary: Presents GUIDE, a goal-initialized end-to-end visual navigation method for legged robots that operates from a single initial goal using intrinsic spatial memory, removing reliance on continuous external goal updates. Addresses myopic behavior under partial observability.

entry.title: MV-Actor: Aligning Multi-View Semantics and Spatial Awareness for Bimanual Manipulation

author.name: Yinchen Tian, Huan Li, Muyao Peng, Xi Wang, Yan Wang, You Yang

entry.summary: Presents MV-Actor, a multi-view perception framework for bimanual manipulation that builds a unified semantic-spatial representation via cross-view semantic interaction and semantic-spatial token grounding. Improves over shallow or independent view encoding.

entry.title: TacForeSight: Force-Guided Tactile World Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation

author.name: Yujie Zang, Yuhang Zheng, Xian Nie, Yupeng Zheng, Shuai Tian, Songen Gu, Chen Gao, Zining Wang, Shuicheng Yan, Wenchao Ding

entry.summary: Proposes JOIN, an on-demand heterogeneous bimanual assistive system where a wheelchair-mounted anchor arm is joined by a summoned mobile manipulator to handle fundamentally bimanual daily tasks. Avoids the cost and space drawbacks of adding a second wheelchair arm.

entry.title: Structure from Reasoning, Numbers from Search: On-Premise Open LLMs as Structural Priors for Coupled MIMO Controller Tuning

author.name: Jiaxuan Chen, Haonan Li, Yang Shu

entry.summary: Investigates whether on-premise open LLMs can serve as structural priors for tuning coupled MIMO industrial controllers, finding classical methods win for simple loops but LLM-guided structure plus numerical search helps strongly coupled systems. Tested on CSTR and quadruple-tank benchmarks.

entry.title: HMAF: A Hierarchical Multi-Slot GD-RTB Allocation Framework

author.name: Tianxing Bu, Zhaoqi Zhang, Linyou Cai, Miao Xie, Shengri Xue, Tan Qu, Qianlong Xie, Xingxing Wang, Siqiang Luo, Gao Cong

entry.summary: Proposes HMAF, a hierarchical multi-slot allocation framework for online advertising that jointly optimizes Guaranteed Delivery contracts and Real-Time Bidding auctions using a Plan-Calibrate-Execute paradigm. It balances short-term revenue with long-term contract delivery under complex constraints.

entry.title: Deep Slice Interpolation for Reducing Through-Plane Anisotropy and Noise in Head CT

author.name: Luis Cort\'es Ferre, Miguel A. Guti\'errez-Naranjo, Marcin Balcerzyk

entry.summary: Presents a deep learning system that synthesizes intermediate CT slices from neighboring axial slices to halve through-plane spacing while also denoising, improving 3D visualization and volumetric measurements in head CT. It systematically evaluates pixel-wise loss choices.

entry.title: Temporal Context Conditioning for Seasonality-Aware Precipitation Nowcasting of High-Intensity Rainfall

author.name: Gijs van Nieuwkoop, Siamak Mehrkanoon

entry.summary: Proposes TA-SmaAt-UNet, extending a small-attention U-Net with cyclical time-of-day and time-of-year conditioning to improve radar-based precipitation nowcasting of high-intensity rainfall. It adds lightweight temporal context to short-term radar models.

entry.title: Boosting ECG Classification Performance by Pre-training with Synthesized Data

author.name: Naoki Nonaka, Jun Seita

entry.summary: Investigates pre-training ECG classifiers on knowledge-driven synthetic data generated via a Gaussian-composition simulator modeling P, Q, R, S, T wave components. Targets data scarcity for rare cardiac abnormalities like AF and atrial flutter.

entry.title: SinkRec: Mitigating Semantic State Sink in Long Sequence Recommendation with Memory-Conditioned Gated Delta Networks

author.name: Zhuang Zhuang, Zhipeng Wei, Ji Dai, Jie Chen, Fei Pan, Peng Jiang, Kun Gai

entry.summary: Introduces SinkRec, a hybrid memory-transition architecture that addresses a failure mode in linear-attention recommenders where repetitive user behaviors over-dominate the compressed recurrent state. It externalizes recurring patterns into a learnable quantized memory using gated delta networks to debias readouts in long-sequence recommendation.

entry.title: Trainability of IQP Quantum Circuit Born Machines Under Gaussian Initialization

author.name: Gennaro De Luca

entry.summary: This paper rigorously analyzes the trainability of IQP Quantum Circuit Born Machines under Gaussian parameter initialization, addressing barren plateau and exponential concentration issues. It extends prior analysis beyond uniform parameter distributions.

entry.title: Bidirectional Random Projections

author.name: Chao Lan, Luyuan Yang

entry.summary: This work analyzes bidirectional random projections for OLS regression, deriving excess loss bounds in both sample and feature dimensions with comparison to single-direction projection. It validates the theoretical implications on real-world data.

entry.title: U-TTT: Towards Generalizable PET Image Denoising via Test-Time Training

author.name: Zhiwen Yang, Jiayin Li, Hao Lu, Hui Zhang, Zihua Wang, Bingzheng Wei, Yan Xu

entry.summary: Proposes U-TTT, a U-shaped PET denoising model with test-time training layers that self-supervisedly adapt parameters at inference to handle distribution shifts like varying dose or scanner type. Aims for robust clinical generalization.

entry.title: Self-Supervised Relevance Modelling in Autonomous Driving via Counterfactual Analysis

author.name: Luca Lusvarghi, Javier Gozalvez, Pablo Urbano Hidalgo

entry.summary: Proposes a self-supervised counterfactual-analysis approach to learn an object relevance model for autonomous driving, quantifying which detected objects actually affect driving decisions to save compute and reduce noise propagation. Improves perception-pipeline efficiency.

entry.title: Gradient based Bilevel for Inverse Optimal Control, a Riemannian approach

author.name: Ahmed-Manaf Dahmani, Vincent Bonnet, David Daney, Fran\c{c}ois Charpillet

entry.summary: Reformulates inverse optimal control as a Riemannian gradient-based bilevel problem, showing optimality-condition trajectories form a manifold and addressing numerical instability from constraint-qualification violations. Improves IOC tractability for realistic systems.

entry.title: Accelerating NeurASP with vectorization and caching

author.name: Alexander Philipp Rader, Alessandra Russo

entry.summary: Accelerates the NeurASP neurosymbolic framework via vectorization, batch processing, and caching to overcome the expensive non-differentiable ASP probability and gradient computations. Improves scalability to more sophisticated reasoning tasks.

entry.title: PatchSTG: Scalable Spatiotemporal Graph Transformers for Traffic Forecasting on Irregular Sensor Networks

author.name: Jichao Li, Xuanming Shi

entry.summary: Presents PatchSTG, a patch-based spatiotemporal graph Transformer that partitions irregularly distributed traffic sensors into balanced local patches for efficient and scalable traffic forecasting. It addresses non-uniform sensor distributions and high computational cost of large-scale modeling.

entry.title: Emotion Profiling in LLM-Based Literary Translation: Systematic Shifts Across MT and Post-Editing

author.name: Antonio Castaldo, Johanna Monti, Sheila Castilho

entry.summary: Investigates emotional profiles in LLM-based literary translation, comparing machine translations of Atwood's Oryx and Crake with post-edited and human versions against an Italian science-fiction corpus. It finds MT systems introduce model-specific statistically significant emotional fingerprints, limiting preservation of authorial voice.

entry.title: Automated Pronunciation Evaluation for Korean Toddler Speech using Speech Diarization and Self-Supervised Learning

author.name: Diane Myung-kyung Woodbridge, Jee Hyun Suh

entry.summary: This paper presents an end-to-end pipeline for automated pronunciation evaluation of Korean toddler speech, combining neural speaker diarization with self-supervised speech representations. It introduces a new IRB-approved corpus of 53 child recordings and evaluates multiple diarization models for this underserved clinical task.

entry.title: Content-Induced Spatial-Spectral Aggregation Network for Change Detection in Remote Sensing Images

author.name: Yunlong Liu, Zekai Zhang

entry.summary: CSI-Net is a content-guided spatial-spectral integration network for change detection in remote sensing images, combining spatial reasoning via graph convolutions, spectral difference modeling, and content-guided integration. It aims to suppress spatial and spectral differences in unchanged areas.

entry.title: Generative Explainability for Next-Generation Networks: LLM-Augmented XAI with Mutual Feature Interactions

author.name: Kiarash Rezaei, Omran Ayoub, Sebastian Troia, Francesco Lelli, Paolo Monti, Carlos Natalino

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-augmented XAI framework for next-generation networks that extends beyond SHAP values by incorporating mutual feature interaction data into structured prompts to generate human-understandable explanations for non-specialists. Targets operator trust in network AI/ML.

entry.title: DUET -- Dual User Embedding Transformers for Offsite Conversion Prediction

author.name: Reazul Hasan Russel, Mingwei Tang, Rostam Shirani, Xinlong Liu, Navid Madani, Leo Ding, Yawen He, Xiangyu Wang, Mustafa Acar, Ashish Katiyar, Yuhai Li, Alan Yang, Metarya Ruparel, Derek Qiang Xu, Rupert Wu, Rui Yang, Liang Tao, Xinyi Zhao, Larry Zhang, Sri Reddy, Rob Malkin

entry.summary: Presents DUET, a dual-encoder pretraining framework for offsite conversion-rate prediction that separates clicks and conversions into domain-coherent streams rather than using a single undifferentiated encoder. It addresses the heterogeneity of abundant click signals versus sparse, delayed conversion signals under serving-latency constraints.

entry.title: When Design Rules Break: Benchmark Composition Determines Whether Label Informativeness Predicts GNN Aggregator Choice

author.name: Neha Sharma, Ritesh Sharma

entry.summary: Empirically tests whether GNN aggregator-selection design rules generalize across 24 node-classification datasets, finding edge homophily weakly predictive and label informativeness predictive only on legacy benchmarks but failing on dense Facebook-100 graphs. It highlights how benchmark composition determines whether design rules hold.

entry.title: SPACR: Single-Pass Adaptive Training of Uncertainty-Aware Conformal Regressors

author.name: Soundouss Messoudi, Sylvain Rousseau, S\'ebastien Destercke

entry.summary: Duplicate entry placeholder; see prior DGF analysis.

entry.title: JGRA: Jacobian Geometry Robustness Assessment in NISQ Noise-Aware Quantum Neural Networks

author.name: Gianluca Scanu, Luca Barletta, Stefano Rini

entry.summary: JGRA is a framework for assessing robustness in noise-aware quantum neural networks under realistic NISQ noise using Jacobian geometry. It seeks to transfer classical notions of structural redundancy and robustness to quantum machine learning.

entry.title: Profy: Interpretable Visualization of Expertise-Dependent Motor Skills Toward Supporting Piano Practice

author.name: Kazuki Kawamura, Fujiki Nakamura, Hayato Nishioka, Momoko Shioki, Shinichi Furuya, Jun Rekimoto

entry.summary: Profy is a weakly supervised system that learns from take-level listener ratings to produce time-aligned highlights for piano practice review, using synchronized 1kHz key-motion and audio from 73 pianists. It outputs interpretable clip-level predictions with evidence scores for visualization.

entry.title: Compiling Rewrite Rules to Finite-State Transducers with the Worsening Trick

author.name: Mans Hulden, Michael Ginn

entry.summary: This paper presents a compact compilation scheme for converting rewrite rules into finite-state transducers using a worsening trick that generates all legal candidates then filters suboptimal ones. It simplifies traditional intricate transducer composition methods.

entry.title: Listen, Look, and Learn: Learning Without Forgetting through SAM-Audio

author.name: Avi Gupta, Nilotpal Sinha, Vishnu Raj, Sambuddha Saha, Pratik Joshi, Koteswar Rao Jerripothula, Tammam Tillo

entry.summary: Proposes integrating SAM-Audio audio-visual priors into class-incremental learning with a guided attention strategy where audio contextually steers visual features. Addresses underexplored audio-visual continual learning to mitigate forgetting.

entry.title: AnyMod-LLVE: Low-Light Video Enhancement with Modality-Agnostic Inference

author.name: Hangfeng Liang, Yutao Hu, Yanhan Hu, Xiaohan Wu, Wenqi Shao, Ying Fu

entry.summary: Proposes AMNet for low-light video enhancement that supports modality-agnostic inference, learning to use auxiliary modalities (events, infrared) during training but operating without them at test time via a dual-gated translator. Improves real-world applicability.

entry.title: Bridging Semantics and Physical Execution: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Multi-Pair Robotic Assembly

author.name: Xinyi Li, Aiguo Song, Linhu Wei, Huijun Li

entry.summary: Proposes an end-to-end neuro-symbolic framework for multi-pair robotic assembly that generates per-pair optimal subgraphs and resolves cross-pair interferences, bridging semantic decision-making with physical execution. Addresses state-space explosion and logical hallucinations.

entry.title: JOIN: Anchor-Grasp-Conditioned Joining via Opposition, Inference, and Navigation for Bimanual Assistive Manipulation

author.name: Drake Moore, Matt Cheng, Xiang Zhi Tan, Ta\c{s}k{\i}n Pad{\i}r

entry.summary: Proposes EM-Fall, an embodied fall-detection framework on a mobile humanoid robot integrating mmWave sensing with robotic mobility to actively adjust sensing viewpoint and maintain target observability across rooms and lighting conditions. Addresses limitations of wearables and fixed installations.

entry.title: [Linkpost] Evals for “SPI-incompatible” behavior & reasoning: Guide to initial research

author.name: Anthony DiGiovanni

entry.summary: A linkpost and guide from CLR elaborating how to evaluate models for behavior and reasoning incompatible with safe Pareto improvements (SPI), describing a proposed workflow, next steps, and criteria for clearly bad SPI-incompatibilities. It advances the cooperative-AI safety agenda focused on multi-agent bargaining outcomes.

entry.title: ReflectiChain: Epistemic Grounding in LLM-Driven World Models for Supply Chain Resilience

author.name: Jia Luo

entry.summary: Presents ReflectiChain, combining a generative supply-chain world model with double-loop learning that separates epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty for resilient decision-making. Bridges the gap between LLM semantic understanding and RL physical grounding in supply chains.

entry.title: Architect-Ant: Editable Automatic Furnishing of Architectural Floor Plans

author.name: Fedor Rodionov, Aleksandar Cvejic, Michael Birsak, John Femiani, Peter Wonka

entry.summary: Introduces AntPlan-270, a curated dataset of 270 professional floor plans with per-room furniture annotations, and Architect-Ant, an editable automatic furnishing framework powered by a fine-tuned VLM using a coordinate-based DSL. Addresses the lack of real annotated furnished floor-plan data.

entry.title: Forward-Only Convolutional Neural Networks with Learnable Channel-Class Assignment

author.name: Mohammadnavid Ghader, Saeed Reza Kheradpisheh, Bahar Farahani, Mahmood Fazlali

entry.summary: Extends the biologically inspired Forward-Forward algorithm to CNNs with a learnable channel-class assignment mechanism and entropy/orthogonality regularization, replacing static channel-class partitions. It also proposes loss-aware weighting of intermediate-layer predictions.

entry.title: The Distributed Detectability Band Against Marginal-Preserving Attacks

author.name: Zhang Qinqin, Gao Yuze

entry.summary: FPQC-SAC is a Soft Actor-Critic variant for low-signal-to-noise financial reinforcement learning that inserts a parameterized quantum circuit before actor and critic networks to constrain feature propagation. It aims to mitigate the Financial Entropy Trap where noisy states produce unreliable Q-values amplified by bootstrapping.

entry.title: ++nnU-Net: Scaling nnU-Net with Prefix-Based Data Augmentation

author.name: Ana Sofia Santos, Andr\'e Ferreira, Gijs Luijten, Naida Solak, Lisle Faray de Paiva, Behrus Hinrichs-Puladi, Jens Kleesiek, Jan Egger, Victor Alves

entry.summary: Introduces ++nnU-Net, a registration-based data augmentation module that warps images prior to nnU-Net preprocessing to expand scarce medical segmentation data while preserving anatomical feasibility. Evaluated on five 2D datasets.

entry.title: Designed by Journalists, but Is It for Readers? Rethinking AI Disclosures and Transparency in News

author.name: Pooja Prajod

entry.summary: Examines AI disclosure practices in journalism, finding that detailed disclosures can paradoxically reduce reader trust (a transparency dilemma) while one-line labels create information gaps. Rethinks how newsrooms should communicate AI involvement to readers.

entry.title: LMT: A Bayesian Framework for Causal Discovery from Textual Alarm Records in Manufacturing Systems

author.name: Xiaofeng Xiao, Jianhong Chen, Qiuzhuang Sun, Naichen Shi, Xubo Yue

entry.summary: Proposes LMT, a Bayesian framework that combines LLM-extracted semantic signals from textual alarm logs with causal discovery to identify which manufacturing events causally trigger others. It addresses the gap that LLM semantic patterns alone confuse correlation with causation.

entry.title: Integrating Out, Twice:The Open-System Case That Neural-Network Ensemble Theory Is Missing

author.name: Jin Lei

entry.summary: Draws a formal parallel between neural network ensemble averaging (closed Gaussian marginalization via Schur complement) and the open-system case from nuclear reaction theory, importing the non-Hermitian optical model and generalized optical theorem to fill a gap in ensemble theory. It is a single-author conceptual bridge between physics and ML.

entry.title: Parallel Causal Associative Fields: Gated Sparse Memory for Long-Context Language Modeling

author.name: Muhammad Ahmed

entry.summary: Introduces Parallel Causal Associative Fields, a content-addressed sparse memory over causal successor records that hashes local context into buckets, retrieves candidates, and mixes a cache distribution with a parametric local model via a learned gate. It explores a third primitive between quadratic attention and recurrent compression for long-context LMs.

entry.title: Geometry-Aware Reinforcement Learning for 2D Irregular Nesting

author.name: Auguste Lehuger, Guillaume Henon-Just

entry.summary: Argues RL is well-suited to the 2D irregular nesting problem and introduces the Polygons Transformer, a geometry-aware encoder allowing cross-polygon attention, paired with an optimization policy that learns geometric priors from data. It contrasts with geometry-blind heuristic solvers.

entry.title: PL-KKT-hPINN: Enforcing Nonlinear Equality Constraints on Neural Networks via Piecewise-Linear Projection

author.name: Fateme Mohammad Mohammadi, Hector Budman, Joshua L. Pulsipher

entry.summary: Proposes PL-KKT-hPINN, extending hard-constrained PINNs to enforce nonlinear equality constraints exactly at inference via piecewise-linear projection using KKT conditions, demonstrated on a CSTR reactor case study. It addresses that standard PINNs only enforce physics as soft constraints.

entry.title: Multimodal Brain Tumour Classification Using Feature Fusion

author.name: Wajih ul Islam, Muhammad Yaqoob, Javed Ali Khan, Volker Steuber

entry.summary: This work proposes a two-branch multimodal network combining raw MRI scans with 91 radiomic features to classify brain tumors, using various fusion strategies. It aims to replicate clinicians' multimodal reasoning rather than relying on images alone.

entry.title: Interpretable Temporal Facial-Region Motion Analysis for In-the-Wild Parkinson's Disease Video Classification

author.name: Riyadh Almushrafy (Majmaah University, Saudi Arabia)

entry.summary: This paper examines whether temporal facial-region motion descriptors can support in-the-wild Parkinson's disease video classification on the YouTubePD benchmark, emphasizing interpretability via region ablation and permutation importance. It compares geometric and sequence-based descriptors.

entry.title: UniPET: a universal network for high-quality PET image denoising across varied dose reduction factors

author.name: Zhiwen Yang, Yang Zhou, Haowei Chen, Hui Zhang, Dan Zhao, Bingzheng Wei, Yan Xu

entry.summary: Presents UniPET, a universal PET denoising model that uses domain generalization to handle varied dose reduction factors and avoid over-smoothing from style misalignment across DRFs. Improves practical robustness over fixed-DRF approaches.

entry.title: Time-frequency localization of bird calls in dense soundscapes

author.name: Simen Hexeberg, Fanghui Tong, Hari Vishnu, Mandar Chitre

entry.summary: Formulates bird vocalization detection as spectrogram object detection using YOLO11, localizing calls in time and frequency in dense tropical soundscapes, with an open annotation tool and a new IoMin metric. Nearly doubles baseline detection performance.

entry.title: Deterministic Denominator Design for Localized Tamed Stochastic-Gradient Langevin Dynamics

author.name: Yiwei Zhou, Ziheng Chen

entry.summary: Studies deterministic-denominator design for localized tamed stochastic-gradient Langevin dynamics, fixing the state-dependent envelope before sampling and providing a practical recipe with proxy scores, quantile thresholds, and calibration plus error analysis. Stabilizes large drifts without altering conditional mean.

entry.title: A complementary study on PlanGPT: Evaluation with defined Performance Metrics and comparison with a planner

author.name: Youssef Abdelkader, Humbert Fiorino, Damien Pellier

entry.summary: A complementary reproduction study of PlanGPT, re-running experiments to verify whether LLM-based automated planning is genuinely worthwhile and comparing it against a classical planner. Evaluates plan coverage claims with defined performance metrics.

entry.title: Attention Expansion: Enhancing Keyphrase Extraction from Long Documents with Attention-Augmented Contextualized Embeddings

author.name: Roberto Mart\'inez-Cruz, Alvaro J. L\'opez-L\'opez, Jos\'e Portela

entry.summary: Proposes an attention expansion mechanism that augments PLM token representations with information from out-of-context chunks to improve keyphrase extraction in long documents. Avoids the cost of long-context LLMs while capturing scattered evidence.

entry.title: Structured Adaptive Tensor Prediction for Streaming Data

author.name: Zhen Qin, Yang Chen

entry.summary: Develops an adaptive tensor-regression framework for streaming matrix-valued time series, introducing Matrix-on-Matrix and Tensor-on-Matrix formulations for online forecasting in time-varying environments. It extends adaptive filtering beyond scalar/vector data.

entry.title: Nonlinear Estimator: Dual Bayesian Affine Estimators for Parameter Learning

author.name: Sasan Vakili, Dani\"el Woonings, Pradyumna Paruchuri, Peyman Mohajerin Esfahani

entry.summary: Presents a nonlinear parameter estimator for Wiener-type state-space models built as a fixed-point coupling of two affine MMSE estimators (parameters and latent variables) augmented with dynamic basis statistics. Two construction strategies yield dual basis-parameter and state-parameter estimators.

entry.title: When Metrics Disagree: A Meta-Analysis of Knowledge-Graph-Completion Model Benchmarking

author.name: Haji Gul, Ajaz Ahmad Bhat

entry.summary: Reframes knowledge-graph-completion evaluation as a multi-criteria decision-making problem and conducts a meta-analysis of seven score aggregators across five tests since MRR, Hits@k, and Mean Rank often produce conflicting rankings. It aims to reduce selective reporting and clarify real progress.

entry.title: A Comprehensive Inference-Time Augmentation Framework in Physiological Signals: Application to PPG-Based AF Detection

author.name: Davood Fattahi, Runze Yan, Saurabh Kataria, Zhaoliang Chen, Xiao Hu

entry.summary: Proposes a unified inference-time augmentation framework for physiological signals applied to PPG-based atrial fibrillation detection, incorporating 13 augmentation methods across time, amplitude, frequency, and artifact domains with optimized parameters. It targets robustness to noise, motion artifacts, and distribution shift at deployment.

entry.title: Effective Training Principles of Physical Reservoirs

author.name: Sobhi Saeed, Mehmet M\"uft\"uoglu, Glitta R. Cheeran, Juliane Heim, Bennet Fischer, Mario Chemnitz

entry.summary: This paper investigates strategies to mitigate overfitting and reduce computational overhead in optical reservoir computers through output pruning and regularization. It compares loss-minimizing search, variance filtering, and random pruning approaches.

entry.title: SPARX: Secure and Privacy-Aware Approximate CNN Acceleration with Edge RISC-V SoC

author.name: Sonu Kumar, Akash Sankhe, Mukul Lokhande, Santosh Kumar Vishvakarma

entry.summary: Presents SPARX, a secure, privacy-aware approximate CNN accelerator on a RISC-V SoC combining custom instructions, logarithmic approximate compute, differential-noise privacy, and challenge-response authentication. Targets efficient, secure edge inference.

entry.title: Robotic Nonprehensile Object Transportation with a Hanging Tray

author.name: Adam Heins, Angela P. Schoellig

entry.summary: Addresses the waiter's problem of transporting an object on a tray suspended by ropes (behaving as a 3D pendulum) rather than a rigidly held tray, exploiting pendular motion to reduce shear and sloshing. Schoellig group contribution to nonprehensile transport.

entry.title: The Machines Lack Honour

author.name: Raymond Douglas

entry.summary: An essay on the AI moral-status debate that maps the field into camps (AI as mere tools, AIs as rich beings deserving respect, and Anthropic's uncertainty stance) and argues for an overlooked fourth position: that AIs may genuinely be capable of suffering and sophisticated moral reasoning, yet directing their behavior could still be acceptable. It probes the philosophy underlying AI welfare discussions.

entry.title: Sim2Schedule: A Simulator-Guided LLM Framework for Autonomous Open-Pit Mine Scheduling

author.name: Mustavi Ibne Masum, Thiago Eustaquio Alves de Oliveira, Mahzabeen Emu

entry.summary: Proposes Sim2Schedule, a simulator-guided LLM framework for autonomous open-pit mine scheduling where the LLM acts as a zero-shot decision agent guided by a custom simulator encoding geotechnical and capacity constraints. Aims to overcome MILP's computational and adaptability limitations.

entry.title: QSplitFL: Capability Aware Deep Q-Learning for Optimal Split Point Selection in Split Federated Learning

author.name: Nazmus Shakib Shadin, Xinyue Zhang, Jingyi Wang, Miao Pan

entry.summary: Proposes QSplitFL, a deep Q-learning framework that adaptively selects the optimal model split point in split federated learning based on heterogeneous device capabilities. It aims to avoid overloading weak devices and improve convergence stability.

entry.title: Anomaly Detection and Root Cause Analysis for Microservice Systems

author.name: Luan Pham

entry.summary: Surveys and addresses five limitations in anomaly detection and root cause analysis for microservice systems, including the separation of detection from RCA, underuse of event data, and lack of standardized datasets. It argues for jointly handling detection and diagnosis under imprecise detection.

entry.title: Fast Exact Nearest-Neighbor Learning for High-Frequency Financial Time Series

author.name: Henry Han, Diane Li

entry.summary: This paper presents a Mojo-language implementation of exact nearest-neighbor learning for high-frequency financial time series, using a SIMD k-d tree with variance-based splitting and compile-time vectorized distance computation. It demonstrates that systems-level optimization can meet real-time latency at scale.

entry.title: Post-Quantum Secure Federated DeFi for Inclusive Banking

author.name: Swati Sachan, Dale Fickett, Richard Buchinger, Theo Miller

entry.summary: Proposes a post-quantum secure federated DeFi framework using lattice-based Fully Homomorphic Encryption to let multiple banks collaboratively assess creditworthiness of underserved individuals without exposing data. Aims to combine quantum-resistant cryptography with financial inclusion goals.

entry.title: Improving Text-Instance Alignment Of Foreground Conditioned Out-Painting Via Customized Concept Embedding

author.name: Yihao Zhao, Xuan Han, Bin He, Mingyu You

entry.summary: Addresses artifacts in foreground-conditioned outpainting where backgrounds inadvertently share foreground semantics, attributing it to embedding misalignment. Proposes a Customized Concept Embedding approach to improve text-instance alignment for product display images.

entry.title: Optuna Constrained Tree-Structured Parzen Estimator Is a Joint Density Generalization of c-TPE

author.name: Shuhei Watanabe, Kaichi Irie

entry.summary: Provides a theoretical analysis of Optuna's widely-used constrained TPE hyperparameter optimizer, showing it is equivalent to a joint-density generalization of c-TPE. It proves the joint formulation is invariant to constraint duplication whereas the independent version degrades.

entry.title: Beyond Explaining Predictions: Logic-Based Explanations for Confidence in Machine Learning Models

author.name: Vin\'icius Peixoto Chagas, Carlos Henrique Leit\~ao Cavalcante, Thiago Alves Rocha

entry.summary: Introduces a Minimum Confidence Threshold for logic-based abductive explanations, quantifying the weakest confidence guarantee an explanation provides so explanations do not cover low-confidence instances. It extends formal explainability from prediction to model confidence.

entry.title: Learning Doubly Sparse Explicitly Conditioned Transforms

author.name: Tudor Pistol

entry.summary: Develops interpretable ML models (Pre-AF 13) predicting medium-term atrial fibrillation risk in cardiovascular-disease patients over 24-month and full follow-up horizons using routinely collected hospital discharge data. It targets stratification gaps left by established long-term AF risk scores.

entry.title: Stochastic weather generators for high-frequency wind vector time series

author.name: Mingshi Cui, Kevin Eng, Justin T. Greene, Zern Ke, Abolfazl Sodagartojgi, Zhiqiu Xia, Gemma E. Moran, Michael L. Stein

entry.summary: This paper develops machine learning models to generate realistic minute-scale surface wind vector time series at an Oklahoma site using 30+ years of data. The generator targets applications in wind energy, wildfire spread, and aviation.

entry.title: Do LLMsMakeNeural Distinguishers Wise?

author.name: Tatsuya Sakagami, Masashi Hisai, Naoto Yanai

entry.summary: This paper proposes LLM-based neural distinguishers for symmetric-key cryptanalysis through prompt design, testing on SPECK-32/64. It finds that LLMs provide no observable improvement over ResNet-based neural distinguishers from prior work.

entry.title: Benchmarking stereo reconstruction for 3D printable Martian terrain models

author.name: Josephine Wang

entry.summary: This paper benchmarks stereo reconstruction pipelines for producing 3D-printable Martian terrain models from rover imagery, finding that RAFT-Stereo outperforms SGBM on Middlebury but does not transfer well to low-texture Martian terrain. It highlights a benchmark-to-real-world transfer gap.

entry.title: Don't waste SAM

author.name: Nermeen Abou Baker, Uwe Handmann

entry.summary: This study evaluates the generalization of Meta's Segment Anything Model and fine-tunes it on three waste segmentation datasets featuring occlusions, deformable objects, and transparency. It argues SAM remains a valuable starting point even where zero-shot accuracy is insufficient.

entry.title: Deep learning for echo sounder data

author.name: Ketil Malde

entry.summary: This position/perspective paper argues that meaningful advances in deep learning for echo sounder and underwater acoustic data will require methods beyond recycling image-processing models, given intrinsic acoustic data properties. It highlights how the lack of standard data formats hinders progress.

entry.title: The 1st PortraitCraft Challenge: A CVPR 2026 Workshop Competition on Portrait Composition Understanding and Generation

author.name: Zijie Lou, Youyun Tang, Xiaochao Qu, Haoxiang Li, Ting Liu, Luoqi Liu, Xun Zhu, Zheng Zhang, Xi Chen, Miao Li, Ji Wu, Dizhe Zhang, Xian Ge, Sujia Wang, Ruiyang Zhang, Jiaming Wang, Xianshun Wang, Lu Qi, Boao Kang, Wei Zhou, Jinghui Sun, Zhenyu Yan, Jiliang Zhao, Rui Yang, Yipo Huang, Boyuan Liu, Shanglin Li, Zifan Xie, Yichen Zhang, Anlan Wang, Wenfeng Lin, Mingyu Guo, Dong Li, Xinghao Wang, Yanting Li, Shanzhao Tong, Shuai He, Qiu Zhou, Yongqi Yang, Taoyang Mu, Dianqiao Lei, Anlong Ming, Huadong Ma

entry.summary: Overview of the inaugural CVPR 2026 PortraitCraft challenge, introducing a unified benchmark with two tracks for portrait composition understanding and constraint-aware generation. Moves beyond global aesthetic scoring toward structured compositional control.

entry.title: Overlapped Wavelet Diffusion for Low-Light Image Enhancement

author.name: Fen Peng, Taizo Suzuki, Seisuke Kyochi

entry.summary: Proposes an overlapped wavelet diffusion framework for low-light image enhancement that uses overlapped wavelet transforms to prevent blocking artifacts and better restore high-frequency detail. Improves over prior wavelet-diffusion methods like DiffLL.

entry.title: Multi-UAV Active Sensing with Information Gain-based Planning and Belief Fusion

author.name: S. Habibi, L. Marques

entry.summary: Provides real-world validation of a multi-UAV active sensing framework for probabilistic binary terrain mapping using information-gain-based informative path planning and factor-graph belief fusion, applied to precision agriculture. Compares against random-walk baselines.

entry.title: From Perception to Action: Can UI Interventions Foster Sustainable LLM Chatbot

author.name: Nitish Patkar, Pooja Rani, Jack Gl\"asser, Simon L\"uscher, Martin Kropp

entry.summary: Investigates whether sustainability-oriented UI interventions can raise users' energy awareness and encourage more energy-responsible chatbot use without harming usability. Combines a 77-participant baseline survey with a three-mode chatbot prototype.

entry.title: Spatiotemporal Graph Transformer for 3D Neighborhood Interaction and Quality Prediction in Metal Additive Manufacturing

author.name: Joyce Karen Pelaez, Siqi Zhang, Hoo Sang Ko

entry.summary: Develops a spatiotemporal graph transformer to model 3D neighborhood interactions across layers in metal additive manufacturing and predict build quality from sensor data. It captures multi-layer melting/reheating effects that prior methods underrepresent.

entry.title: A Unified Adaptive Feature Composition Framework for Multi-Task Generalization in Wireless Foundation Models

author.name: Yuxuan Shi, Tingting Yang, Kangning Ma, Liwen Jing, Yuwei Wang, Mengfan Zheng, Li Sun

entry.summary: Proposes a unified adaptive feature-composition framework for wireless foundation models using a Routing Adapter that treats hidden states from different transformer depths as a reusable pool for multi-task downstream adaptation. It aims to avoid both heavy fine-tuning and suboptimal frozen feature extraction.

entry.title: Privacy-Preserving Credit Risk Prediction with Alternative Data

author.name: Hongzhe Zhang, Jiarong Xu, Jing He, Xiao Fang

entry.summary: Proposes a privacy-preserving credit-risk prediction approach that leverages alternative data (e.g., mobile communication data) held by external entities without directly sharing it with financial institutions. It addresses the conflict between richer borrower profiling and consumer privacy.

entry.title: Toward Proactive RF Charging Scheduling: Generative AI for Decision Support

author.name: Amirhossein Azarbahram, Osmel M. Rosabal, David Ernesto Ruiz-Guirola, Melike Erol-Kantarci, Kaibin Huang, Onel L. A. L\'opez

entry.summary: This article positions generative AI as a decision-support tool for proactive RF wireless power transfer charging scheduling, where it can forecast multiple plausible charging scenarios under uncertain conditions. It addresses scheduler-level resource allocation under incomplete receiver-side information.

entry.title: MOFA-VTON: More Fashion Possibilities with Fine-Grained Adaptations in Virtual Try-On

author.name: Xiaoyu Han, Chenyang Wang, Jing Wang, Shunyuan Zheng, Quanling Meng, Shengping Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MOFA-VTON, a virtual try-on method enabling fine-grained, flexible clothing adaptations beyond simple garment replacement to support diverse wearing styles. Targets more controllable and realistic fashion try-on.

entry.title: ros2probe: Non-intrusive, Kernel-selective Observability for Robot Operating System 2 Middleware

author.name: Jisang Yu, Sanghoon Lee, Yeonwoo Choi, Kyung-Joon Park

entry.summary: Introduces ros2probe, a non-intrusive kernel-selective observability tool for ROS 2 / DDS middleware, formalizing and mitigating the observer probe effect that perturbs the system being measured. Improves real-time robot monitoring fidelity.

entry.title: Unsupervised Deep Learning for Limited-Angle STEM-EDX Tomography -- Application to 3D Chemical Analysis of Phase-Change Memory Devices

author.name: Daniel del Pozo Bueno, Serge Brosset, Theo Monniez, Gabriele Navarro, Philippe Ciuciu, Zineb Saghi

entry.summary: This work introduces an unsupervised deep learning framework based on Deep Image Prior with total variation regularization for limited-angle STEM-EDX tomography, with a multi-channel extension that jointly reconstructs multiple elemental maps. It addresses missing-wedge artefacts and low-dose noise for 3D chemical analysis of phase-change memory devices.

entry.title: Mobility Anomaly Generation using LLM-Driven Behavior with Kinematic Constraints

author.name: Yueyang Liu, Joon-Seok Kim, Andreas Z\"ufle

entry.summary: Proposes generating synthetic human trajectory anomalies using LLM-driven behavior combined with kinematic constraints, addressing the severe lack of ground-truth anomaly datasets in mobility research. Aims to overcome data scarcity from privacy and the rarity of anomalous events.

entry.title: Large-scale semantic mapping of learner agency and autonomy reveals what measurement and generative AI research overlook

author.name: Fei Qin, Xiaobo Liu, Yaowen Zhang, Xuming Li, Fei Wang, Mutlu Cukurova, Jingjing Chen, Yu Zhang

entry.summary: Performs a large-scale semantic mapping of learner agency and autonomy from over 14,000 publications, extracting 8,954 definitions and 2,700 scale items to resolve the jingle-jangle fallacy. Identifies three dimensions and highlights what measurement and generative AI research overlook.

entry.title: The Bioelectrical Information Theory: Investigating the theoretical compression limit of bioelectrical signals under artificial intelligence

author.name: Jiawen Zou, Bo Yan

entry.summary: Proposes an information-theoretic framework for bioelectrical signal compression that defines effective information through a three-level hierarchy of signal fidelity, physiological structure, and downstream task requirements, rather than raw waveform entropy. It reframes BCI data compression limits.

entry.title: Divide-and-Conquer Modeling for the CTF-4-Science Lorenz Benchmark

author.name: Shundong Li

entry.summary: Presents a divide-and-conquer modeling strategy for the CTF-4-Science Lorenz benchmark, matching each prediction block to its task group (clean forecasting, noisy reconstruction, few-shot, parametric generalization) rather than forcing a single model class. It combines smoothing reconstruction, NG-RC/NVAR models, and fitted Lorenz corrections.

entry.title: Towards Robust Arabic Speech Emotion Recognition with Deep Learning

author.name: Youcef Soufiane Gheffari, Samiya Silarbi

entry.summary: This study investigates robust Arabic speech emotion recognition using deep learning, comparing CNN-LSTM, CNN-Transformer, and fine-tuned wav2vec 2.0 architectures. It addresses the underexplored challenge of Arabic SER given dialectal diversity and limited annotated datasets.

entry.title: A Unified Siamese Learning Framework for Zero-Day Anomaly Detection and Classification in Optical Networks

author.name: Carlos Natalino, Fl\'avia P. Monteiro, Paolo Monti

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-similarity Siamese network unifying zero-day anomaly detection and one-shot classification in optical networks, claiming over 99% accuracy and instant adaptability to unseen anomalies without retraining. Very terse abstract.

entry.title: Spatiotemporal Seismic Hazard Assessment Using VQ-VAE and Seismic Statistical Features

author.name: Wei Quan, Denise Gorse

entry.summary: Extends prior seismic hazard work by combining a VQ-VAE autoencoder with curated seismic statistical features to move from whole-region to localized earthquake forecasting using Japanese catalogue data. It demonstrates deep learning value over generic time-series features.

entry.title: Decision-Making under Combinatorial Risk

author.name: Yifan Hong, Hongmiao Fan, Chen Wang

entry.summary: Studies human decision-making under combinatorial risk via an investment-allocation task where risk emerges from multiple components rather than a single given lottery. It finds people favor larger probability increments and that revealing the induced probability distribution substantially shifts behavior.

entry.title: One Step Closer to Ground Truth: A Multi-Scale Residual-Aware Representation Learning Pipeline for Predicting Time Series Data

author.name: Amrijit Biswas, Mustafa Kamal, Robin Krambroeckers, M. M. Lutfe Elahi, Sifat Momen, Nabeel Mohammed, Shafin Rahman

entry.summary: Introduces a two-stage, model-agnostic framework that decouples base forecasting from explicit residual learning to correct systematic residual biases left by transformer time-series models. It treats structured residual error as correctable rather than irreducible noise.

entry.title: Selection, Not Salience: The Shape and Limits of Personalization in Social Highlighting

author.name: Kazuki Nakayashiki, Keisuke Watanabe

entry.summary: This work studies the shape and limits of personalization in social web highlighting using an identity-controlled measurement that isolates whether a person's history predicts their marks better than another reader's. It quantifies personalization gains across reading granularities.

entry.title: Multi-Angular Reflectance Anisotropy Observed from UAV Multispectral Imagery

author.name: Zhenqiang Qin, Chenguang Dai, Min Wang, Xian Li

entry.summary: This study proposes a geometry-aware workflow to extract and quantify multi-angular reflectance anisotropy (BRDF effects) from UAV multispectral imagery using structure-from-motion to refine camera parameters. It enables joint analysis of reflectance and viewing geometry for ground targets.

entry.title: An Uncertainty Estimation Framework for Dose Accumulation in Adaptive Radiotherapy: Application to CBCT-Guided Radiotherapy for Cervical Cancer

author.name: Cedric Hemon, Delphine Lebret, Jean-Claude Nunes, Valentin Boussot, Karine Peignaux, Nathalie Mesgouez-Nebout, Chantal Hanzen, Antoine Simon, Ana\"is Barateau, Renaud de Crevoisier, Caroline Lafond

entry.summary: Introduces IMPACT-DoseAcc, an uncertainty-aware dose accumulation framework for adaptive radiotherapy, applied to CBCT-guided cervical cancer treatment, modeling deformable registration uncertainty. Aims to improve cumulative dose estimation reliability.

entry.title: Continuous Neural Reparameterization as a Deep Geometric Prior for Robust Fixed-Chart UV Repair

author.name: Mohammad Sadegh Salehi

entry.summary: Recasts fixed-chart UV unwrapping as continuous neural reparameterization using an untrained SIREN optimized against a geometric objective, plus a robustness recipe with spectral inputs and validity-checked fallbacks. Aims for robust mesh UV repair.

entry.title: Business World Model

author.name: Cecil Pang, Hiroki Sayama

entry.summary: Introduces a Business World Model (BWM), an architecture that encodes business states, dynamics, constraints, and objectives to support autonomous strategic decision-making by AI systems. It extends the world-model concept from cognitive science and control theory into organizational settings.

entry.title: More Human or More AI? Visualizing Human-AI Collaboration Disclosures in Journalistic News Production

author.name: Amber Kusters, Pooja Prajod, Pablo Cesar, Abdallah El Ali

entry.summary: Through co-design and a within-subjects lab study, explores how visualizing human-AI collaboration disclosures in journalism (textual, timeline, chatbot formats) affects perceptions and gaze patterns. Finds textual disclosures least effective and chatbot formats more engaging.
